description: ADR-106: BY-DESIGN-EXCLUSIVE declarations. Exclusivity is declared, never inferred (hardening 1): every one-track emission must match exactly one declaration below or the parity gate goes red. knownLimitationsInfra lists .claude/hooks/ files that are plumbing (dispatcher/shared lib), not enforcement surface, and therefore carry no Known Limitations row. scanExclusions are minimatch patterns removed from the bake scan (hardening 16) — nondeterministic or non-emission artifacts only.
